scenes.say: Order your glasses from your sofa, delivered anywhere in India. Here are the do's and don'ts.

scenes.en: Keep a recent eye prescription ready.
scenes.say: Do keep a recent eye prescription ready, ideally from the last year.

scenes.en: Frames from ₹899. Single vision lenses from ₹1,500.
scenes.say: Do pick your frame and lenses on our website. Frames start at eight hundred ninety nine rupees, and single vision lenses at fifteen hundred.

scenes.en: Don't guess your power or use a very old one.
scenes.say: Don't guess your power, or use a very old prescription. The wrong power can cause headaches and eye strain.

scenes.en: Free in South India. Elsewhere ₹80, free above ₹999. No cash on delivery.
scenes.say: Delivery is free in South India. Elsewhere it is eighty rupees, and free above nine hundred ninety nine. Please note, there is no cash on delivery.

scenes.en: On spectacles with LenzKare Fusion lenses.
